name: Saving Shield
benefit:
Whenever an adjacent ally is the target of an attack, you can, as an immediate action, grant that adjacent ally a +2 shield bonus to AC. You must be wielding a light shield, heavy shield, or tower shield to use this feat.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 130
When you use this feat, you can spend 2 stamina points to increase the shield bonus granted to your ally by an amount equal to the enhancement bonus of the shield you are using.
flavor: You deflect attacks that could mean your ally’s death.
